# Temple Scroll Column 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 1 | **Condition:** Almost entirely lost; only scattered words survive

---

**1:1** [...] the words of [...] the covenant [...]

**1:2** [...] which [...] the festival of [...] to the LORD [...]

**1:3** [...] for-all their-generations [...] a statute of-eternity [...]

**1:4** [...]

**1:5** [...]

**1:6** [...] and-they-shall-keep [...] the-appointed-time [...]

**1:7** [...]

**1:8** [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 1 is almost entirely destroyed. Only isolated words on scattered fragments are legible — "covenant" (berit), "festival" (chag), "the LORD" (YHWH), "statute of eternity" (chuqqat 'olam). Hyphenated compound forms reflect the construct-chain syntax of the Hebrew. The vast majority of this column is irrecoverable lacuna.*
